TIL that the Titanic is slowly being eaten away by iron-consuming bacteria, losing an estimated 130-200 kg of iron every day. One researcher estimates that it could take several centuries for the entire wreck to disappear
TIL Blowing out candles on a cake increases the amount of bacteria on the surface frosting by 1400%

TIL that in the 1920s, "balloon jumping" was a popular fad where people harnessed themselves to small helium balloons to leap hundreds of feet over fields and buildings, until a series of lethal accidents ended the trend.
TIL that Elvis Presley did 636 sold out shows in Las Vegas and never once performed his song “Viva Las Vegas”

TIL the fruit thrown to Sylvester Stallone during Rocky's famous running montage was completely unscripted—a real street vendor in Philadelphia's Italian Market spontaneously tossed it to him while the crew was filming guerrilla-style.
TIL that Grover Cleveland was the only US President to get married in the White House, and the only President to have a baby born there as well
TIL that the ancient Chinese philosopher Confucius was willing to teach anyone who was eager to learn, asking for nothing more than a simple bundle of dried meat/jerky in exchange.

TIL about Kalawao County, Hawaii. It is the smallest county in the US, and the second least populous, with 82 residents. Historically a leper quarantine colony, it will cease to exist once the last patient resident dies, and be absorbed into the larger Maui county.
TIL owning a pet rabbit is illegal in Queensland, Australia, where rabbits have been a destructive invasive species since being introduced in the 19th century.
TIL that the first functional gasoline-electric hybrid vehicle was designed by Ferdinand Porsche in 1900. He was 25.
